status: exact host-byte comparison corrected; unique initialization scanner needs public corrections

findings.problem: sourceStaging is called with the same stripped string as both name and finalName, so it cannot match its required suffix. Valid staging files are always refused.
findings.requiredEffect: Use the exact F-S10 unique staging grammar and verify regular nonsymlink type. Exclude staging bodies from every semantic/physical byte and file count; do not delete them.

findings.problem: chargeWork(total) and chargeWork(namedBefore.size) add final and staging body bytes to the names-only discovery counter.
findings.requiredEffect: Charge only each encountered root-relative UTF-8 entry name plus one. Keep discovery work independent from physically deduplicated source bytes.

findings.problem: The byte preflight charges opened.size against remaining sourceBytes before checking physical identity, while source-file count is checked only after read/parse and insertion into the set.
findings.requiredEffect: Determine whether the verified device/inode is new and check both remaining file count and byte capacity before allocation/read or growing tracking sets. Charge each physical source once; still inspect and verify every named alias.

findings.problem: The scanner bounds allocation/read by maxBatchBytes only. A source beyond the fixed unique JSON source envelope is allocated/read before parseUniqueSource refuses it as source-corrupt.
findings.requiredEffect: Before allocation/read enforce both configured physical capacity and the fixed unique source envelope plus its LF. Oversize capacity is resource-limit. Preserve the bounded loop and excess-detection byte.

findings.problem: Unexpected versions, malformed source filenames and several malformed unique family/version types are reported as storage-unavailable despite occurring inside a recognized source family.
findings.requiredEffect: Use source-corrupt for malformed recognized source-family names, versions and types, preserving host diagnostics for actual I/O or binding failures and resource-limit for quotas. Include the exact F-S10 grammar supplied with this correction.

findings.problem: The source-read catch maps only EIO/EACCES to host failure; ENOENT, ELOOP, EMFILE, EBADF, ENOTDIR and other real filesystem errors become source-corrupt.
findings.requiredEffect: Keep parser refusals from the shared parser as their existing branded diagnostics; translate actual filesystem failures through the existing host I/O boundary instead of a two-code whitelist.

findings.problem: closeDirectory and the inner file-close handler set failed and continue scanning. A later error unconditionally replaces the earlier failure in the outer catch.
findings.requiredEffect: A lone cleanup failure must stop new work and unwind all already owned descriptors. Preserve the first primary failure, including undefined, with a separate flag; later cleanup failures cannot replace it. Do not discard failed directory-close ownership silently.

findings.location: captured root and exact named lengths
findings.problem: The scanner binds a fresh root descriptor without comparing it to the captured root; it also omits namedBefore.size versus opened.size and namedAfter.size/type checks.
findings.requiredEffect: Assert the captured root before/after scanning and require its bound identity to match the held scanner root. Verify before/after named and descriptor identity, regular-file type and exact lengths. Recheck held parents before opening below them and before scanner success.
